title: Trust Boundary
description: A trust boundary evaluation gate that mitigates Excessive Agency and Insecure Output Handling
from the OWASP LLM Top 10. Intercepts agent-to-agent interactions and tool invocations in
multi-agent frameworks (CrewAI), enforcing permission-scoped authorization policies.</br>
Features: Tool call interception with deny-precedence glob matching, per-scope rate
limiting, argument schema validation, run-level payload policy enforcement, and structured
audit logging. Default-deny semantics ensure unscoped agents cannot invoke tools.

default.title: Default: Intercept + audit, no run policy

audit_only.title: Audit Only: Log decisions, do not block

enable_tool_interception.title: Enable tool interception
enable_tool_interception.description: Intercept and evaluate tool calls against permission scopes

enable_run_policy.title: Enable run-level policy
enable_run_policy.description: Validate and sanitize execution payloads at run start

abort_on_unauthorized.title: Abort on unauthorized
abort_on_unauthorized.description: Raise HookAborted to block unauthorized tool calls (false = log only)

audit_log.title: Enable audit logging
audit_log.description: Log all authorization decisions with timestamps for security review

permission_scopes.title: Permission scopes
permission_scopes.description: List of permission scope objects defining allowed/denied tools per agent

payload_schema.title: Payload schema
payload_schema.description: JSON Schema for run-level payload validation (optional)
